name: ASCEND [BETA]
desc:
❗️❗️ THIS GAME IS NOT EASY YOU WILL DIE ❗❗ 

⭐ Tip : Find the DARK MERCHANT on the SURFACE for special items like PETS and EVENT COSMETICS! ⭐

💎 Premium players start with a FREE REVIVE and 500 PlatCoins! 💎 

❗❗ ARACHNOPHOBIA WARNING ❗❗

You are trapped deep below the surface in a mysterious underground tower and your only escape is up through seemingly endless levels of random deadly minigames. Do you have what it takes to survive the impossible challenges above and make it out alive?

🏆 Collect trinkets in the tower and sell them for PlatCoins!
💰 Buy consumables to aid you in your ascent!
🎄 Customize your character with various cosmetics!
🎉 Complete challenges for more rewards!
🥇 Be number ONE on the leader boards!

👍 Give the game a thumbs up for NEW floors! 👍

Press Q to roll.

Thumbnail artist : fataltragedies
